prs.cluster_pick_reason: PR #1996 replaces the ad-hoc check with a dedicated `acceptsMediaType()` parser that splits the Accept header into entries, strips whitespace/case, and explicitly excludes entries with q=0 and matches type/subtype (including wildcards). PR #2046's visible diff instead swaps the two `.includes('application/json')` / `.includes('text/event-stream')` substring checks directly inline — this is more prone to false positives (e.g. `.includes('application/json')` would also match a media type like `application/json-patch+json` or an explicitly disabled `application/json;q=0` entry) since it does no q-value or exact subtype parsing. #1996's helper function is also independently testable and reusable at the other Accept-header call site in the same file, whereas #2046's fix is a narrower inline patch of the single check.

members.title: chore(client): normalize trailing slashes in discovery paths
members.author: raashish1601
members.reason: [llm] duplicates #2215: Both rewrite the same trailing-slash/pathname-normalization block in buildWellKnownPath (packages/client/src/client/auth.ts) used for OAuth discovery URL construction, so they touch identical lines and will merge-conflict. #2214 fixes multi-trailing-slash inputs producing malformed double-slash discovery paths (e.g. "/foo//.well-known/oauth-authorization-server") by replacing the single-slash-strip with a `pathname.replace(/\/+$/, '')` regex, applied at both call sites (buildWellKnownPath and buildDiscoveryUrls). #2215 factors the same stripping logic into a shared `normalizeDiscoveryPath()` helper used by buildWellKnownPath, and additionally updates `shouldAttemptFallback`'s root-path check from `pathname === '/'` to `pathname === ''` — required because after either PR's normalization, a root path becomes `''` not `'/'`, so the pre-existing "already at root, skip redundant fallback" check never fired.
